best.why: The token, action, and dynamics paths are separated cleanly, then reunited at the prediction loop.
It makes a sprawling data-and-model program navigable with strongly separated task lanes.
The simulator’s actors, state transitions, and stopping condition can be followed without reading the caption.
The paired search trees make the claimed tradeoff immediately visible.
It maps inputs, tokenization, transformer processing, and geometric outputs in one continuous path.

worst.why: The tiny token lanes and comparison branches require zooming before the central distinction is legible.
It crams architecture, matrix cartoons, and several quantitative claims into a figure with no visual resting point.
The schematic uses miniature graphs and dense text, so the causal story is harder to parse than the caption.
